name: N no Shokutaku
source:
A blessed meal is an ingredient to a happy life.

Those who feed on humans, the Neversistas, have lived a life
close to an eternity.
They shoulder a melancholic feeling as they circle around the
dull dining table for yet another time.
However, they cannot stop feeding themselves.

The people fear the unknown Neversistas.
They victimise, hurt, and cast doubt on each other.
However, they cannot stop from being suspicious of others.

Even in this town, a widespread rumour about monsters that
terrorise people has initiated a "Neversista hunt" to
exterminate those that slipped into town.
The endless and repetitive mealtimes, suspicion, and love...

Will they be able to obtain a closure?

[From [url=https://bethygauw.tumblr.com/post/629653711833219072/]Bethygauw's blog[/url]]
translation:
一顿丰盛的饭菜是幸福生活的要素。

那些以人类为食的人，Neversistas，过着一种生活
接近永恒。
他们带着忧郁的心情绕着
又是一次沉闷的餐桌。
然而，他们无法停止进食。

人们害怕未知的内维斯塔。
他们互相伤害、互相伤害、互相怀疑。
然而，他们无法停止对他人的怀疑。

即使在这个小镇里，关于怪物的谣言也广为流传。
恐吓人们发起了一场“Neversista狩猎”
消灭那些溜进城里的人。
无尽重复的用餐时光、猜疑、爱情……

他们能获得结案吗？

[来自[url=https://bethygauw.tumblr.com/post/629653711833219072/]Bethygauw的博客[/url]]
